bluf: Ukraine executed its largest drone attack on Moscow to date, with Russia claiming to have intercepted over 1,900 drones, while simultaneously conducting Russian parliamentary elections that Putin framed as a war-support referendum—signaling intensifying kinetic operations and domestic political consolidation around the conflict. European intelligence chiefs warned Russia could escalate operations against NATO within months rather than years, potentially using drones, missiles, or limited incursions. In the Middle East, Iran's economy is collapsing under sanctions and conflict pressure with GDP plunging 10.1% and inflation reaching 69.9%, while Trump signaled imminent decisions on Iran policy amid Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and escalating regional tensions. The convergence of active large-scale attacks, NATO-directed Russian threat warnings, and acute Iranian economic/military strain represents the highest concentration of kinetic risk across the two flagship theaters.
